adguard_filters.name: AdGuard Filters / Mobile Ads Filter
adguard_filters.reason: Rich Adblock syntax includes cosmetic and request rules. Use as a validation/research signal until the DNS-safe extractor is audited.

goodbyeads.name: GoodbyeAds
goodbyeads.reason: The project documents mixed upstream provenance including copyleft, non-commercial, no-license and all-rights-reserved inputs. Do not wholesale-import into OSFilter until provenance is resolved.

windows_spy_blocker.name: WindowsSpyBlocker
windows_spy_blocker.reason: Useful Windows telemetry research signal, but default host data is old and can affect Windows features. Keep out of default tiers until revalidated.

adaway.name: AdAway default hosts
adaway.reason: Useful mobile-ad signal. Kept outside the GPL aggregate until attribution and data-license treatment is explicitly reviewed.
